name: Log source coverage or retention below what the period requires
description: Security-relevant log sources are absent for part of the in-scope estate, sources stopped forwarding mid-period, or retention is shorter than the examination period so an interval cannot be evidenced regardless of what was collected.

may_assert: That named in-scope assets do not appear as active log sources, where the source list and asset inventory have both been supplied for the same date.
That configured retention is shorter than the examination period.
That a source stopped forwarding during the period, where last-received times show it.
must_not_assert: That an incident went undetected. The observation concerns telemetry coverage, not any actual event.
That any specific retention period is required by SOC 2. None is prescribed; the entity's own period is the benchmark.

escalates_to.when: A whole component class is outside the logging model with no alternative detection, making the shortfall structural rather than a coverage slip.

de_escalates_to.when: No authoritative asset inventory is available, so coverage can be measured against nothing.

severity_factors.criterion_impact: Activity on uncovered components is outside detection entirely, and unretained intervals cannot be examined after the fact.
severity_factors.pervasiveness: One quiet source differs from identity or application logging being absent altogether.
severity_factors.detectability: Detectable only by reconciling to the asset inventory; the platform's own source list always looks complete.
escalates_when: Identity or application logging is absent
Retention is materially shorter than the period
A source stopped forwarding and nobody noticed
de_escalates_when: The uncovered component holds no protected information
An alternative detection control covers the component
The shortfall was detected and closed by the entity within its own window

detection_signals.signal: Assets in the authoritative inventory absent from the active log source list.
Configured retention shorter than the examination period.
Source last-received time materially older than expected for an active source.
Respondent describes coverage without reference to an asset inventory, or cannot state the retention period.

auditor_impact: Auditors commonly request the log source list alongside the asset inventory and reconcile them, and check retention against the period before sampling anything from the logs.
customer_impact: Activity affecting the customer's data on part of the vendor's estate produced no record, or a record that no longer exists.
false_positive_guidance: Not a gap where the component is outside the declared system boundary; confirm the boundary before reconciling.
Not a gap where an ephemeral asset appeared and was destroyed between inventory snapshots; reconcile inventory currency first.
Not a gap where an alternative detection control covers the component and the entity has said so.
Where no authoritative asset inventory exists, report insufficient evidence. Coverage cannot be assessed against an absent denominator.

source_refs.supports: Typical auditor treatment, severity factors, and detection approach.

notes: DriftGuard finding archetype. DriftGuard produces observations against it; only a service auditor issues findings.
